### 15. (1) \( y'=\mathrm{e}^{-x}(1-x^{2})\)  (2) \(y'=-3\sin(3x-1)-\frac{2}{2x-1}\)  (3) \(y'=-2\sqrt{2}\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\)

(4) \(y'=\frac{1-x}{x^{2}\sqrt{2x-1}}\)  (5) \(y'=e^{x}(\sin x+\cos x)+\sin x\)  (6) \(y'=\frac{1}{\cos^ {2} x}+\frac{1}{x}\)

(7) $y' = 1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos x \quad (8)y' = -\frac{1 + (1 - x)\ln(1 - x)}{(1 - x)e^x}$

**详解**（1） $y' = -\mathrm{e}^{-x}(x + 1)^{2} + \mathrm{e}^{-x} \cdot 2(x + 1) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}(1 - x^{2})$

(2) $y' = -3\sin (3x - 1) - \frac{-2}{-2x + 1} = -3\sin (3x - 1) - \frac{2}{2x - 1}$

$$y ^ {\prime} = 2 \cos (2 x) + 2 \cos x (- \sin x) = 2 \cos (2 x) - 2 \sin (2 x) = - 2 \sqrt {2} \sin \left(2 x - \frac {\pi}{4}\right) \tag {3}$$

(4) $y' = \frac{2\sqrt{2x - 1}}{x^2} - \frac{x - 1}{x^2} = \frac{x - (2x - 1)}{x^2\sqrt{2x - 1}} = \frac{1 - x}{x^2\sqrt{2x - 1}}$

(5) $y' = (\mathrm{e}^x\sin x)' - (\cos x)' = \mathrm{e}^x\sin x + \mathrm{e}^x(\sin x)' + \sin x = \mathrm{e}^x(\sin x + \cos x) + \sin x.$

(6) $y = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} + \ln (-x)$ ，则 $y' = \frac{\cos^2 x - \sin x(-\sin x)}{\cos^2 x} + \frac{1}{-x} \cdot (-x)' = \frac{1}{\cos^2 x} + \frac{1}{x}$

(7) $y = x - \frac{1}{2}\sin x$ ，则 $y = 1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos x$ .

$$y = \frac {\frac {1}{1 - x} (1 - x) ^ {\prime} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} - 1 \ln (1 - x) . e ^ {x}}{(\mathrm{e} ^ {x}) ^ {2}} = \frac {- \frac {1}{1 - x} - \ln (1 - x)}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x}} = - \frac {1 + (1 - x) \ln (1 - x)}{(1 - x) \mathrm{e} ^ {x}} \tag {8}$$
